Mission Local has reported on MEDA buying buildings to keep housing affordable. In its January 2018 story, it reported MEDA purchased a 16-unit building at 17th and Mission streets for $7.75 million, and that it had bought a building at 18th and Mission the previous December for $6 million. The story says the purchases used the city’s Small Sites program, which aims to protect longtime residents and neighborhood-serving areas.

I couldn’t verify a story about the planned May 2024 purchase near 16th Street BART from the package provided; the verified package covers the January 2018 story.
